description: Each class holds 25 collected glyphs. Each entry lists the 25 [original, augmented copy] file pairs of a class: the first file of every pair is the original glyph and the second its augmented copy (scripts/augment_dataset.py). Pairing check: for 96.7% of images (15,817 of 16,350) the most similar image in the class (maximum normalized cross-correlation over translations, 64x64 grayscale) is the file-order partner. Order check: the Gaussian-noise transform (sigma=30) leaves a high-frequency signature in 15.4% of second members and 1 of 8,175 first members (scripts/verify_pair_order.py).
